title: Matrix 14mm Cool Water Tool
description:
Matrix 14mm Cool Water Tool
This Cool Water Tool features a matrix perc downstairs that not only provides a pleasing appearance but also gives a higher level of filtration. The Matrix Cool Water Tool also has less draw resistance then its sibling the standard Cool Water Tool.
In the Cool Water Tool the bottom chamber is approximately filled half way with water. Vapour bubbles its way through the bottom chamber then up through the slits in the top chamber. This top chamber helps keep splattering water away from your lips.
Included
1 x Matrix 14mm Cool Water Tool
